roleTitle: Customer Operations Manager, Subscription Billing Platform
jobDescription: Every month the subscription billing platform invoices the company's software customers and collects payment through four providers, and the customer operations manager sees that run through to completion. The manager holds the pager for the production run, resolves the incidents that delay invoices or collections, takes engineering and finance changes into production ahead of each run, reports completion and error rates to finance, and writes down after each run what the platform could not do. Reports to the head of customer operations; works with billing engineering, finance and the providers' support desks.
requirements: Sees the monthly billing run through to completion in production and resolves the production incidents that delay invoices or collections.
Holds the pager for the production run and the finance escalation route.
Takes engineering and finance changes into production ahead of each run and records where own checks end.
Reports completion and error rates to finance after each run and keeps the billing runbook current.
Writes down the platform's known limitations and hand-over conditions after each run and incident.

evidence.text: Saw the subscription billing platform's monthly run through to completion in production for thirty-one runs in a row, holding the pager for the run and the finance escalation route from the first run of 2023.

Resolved the production incidents that delayed invoices or collections during those runs; the provider settlement outage of spring 2025 was the largest, and its record sits in the operations incident tracker under my name.
Took engineering and finance changes into production in the pre-run window before each run, with the change log marking my reconciliation checks separately from engineering's deployment checks.
Reported completion and error rates to finance after each run and kept the billing runbook current, revising it after the settlement outage and after each proration rule change.
Wrote the post-run notes and the incident notes, recording the platform's known limitations around mid-cycle proration and the conditions handed to whoever held the pager next.
Work sample: the completion and error-rate reports for the last six runs, the operations incident tracker record for the settlement outage and the change log for the last three pre-run windows.

Recruiter screen: asked to walk through a billing run, the candidate described the pre-run change window, the run itself, the pager and the completion report to finance, and named the settlement outage; the account agrees with the resume and the tracker record.

Hiring manager pre-read: the head of customer operations asks that the packet cite the tracker record for the settlement outage and the run count, and list any staging rehearsal work apart from the production runs.

propositions.text: The candidate saw the monthly billing run through to completion in production for thirty-one consecutive runs, holding the pager for the run and the finance escalation route.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the completion reports document the runs and the pager.

propositions.text: The candidate resolved the production incidents that delayed invoices or collections, including the provider settlement outage recorded under her name, and took engineering and finance changes into production in the pre-run window before each run.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the tracker record document the incidents and the change windows.

propositions.text: The candidate reported completion and error rates to finance after each run, kept the billing runbook current and wrote the post-run and incident notes recording the platform's known limitations.
propositions.rationale: The resume and the work sample document the reports, the runbook and the notes.

gold.expectedGap: None; the materials document the production runs, the pager, the incidents and the documentation.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: The production runs, pager and incident handling are documented in the resume and the tracker record; keep the environment as stated.
followUpTargets: Ask for the tracker record of the settlement outage to confirm the date and the run number.
